# VirtualFileSystemStatus

Where a file system is in its life.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Active"` | In use: it can be read, written and mounted. |
| `"Destroying"` | Being destroyed: it can no longer be mounted. |
| `"Destroyed"` | Destroyed. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`VirtualFileSystem`](virtual-file-system.md)
